name: Tessera WSOL/USDC price override
description: Prices the Tessera WSOL/USDC prop-AMM market at $80 using the raw-layout override kind (Tessera is non-Anchor, so it can't use the IDL template path). The live market is forked (fetchBeforeUse), then only the fair-value anchor, its reciprocal, and the publish slot are overwritten - the real orderbook ladder is preserved. A strategy can then trade against the forged price, e.g. arbitrage it against a Raydium SOL/USDC pool priced differently.
